defect: REQ and ACK handshake state can be reset independently across the two reset domains
rationale: The source and destination handshake registers use independent asynchronous resets; resetting one side alone can leave the synchronized toggle and acknowledgement phase inconsistent.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the request/acknowledge synchronizer to toggle state, two synchronizer chains and an acknowledgement comparator.

mutation.description: Allowed the source and destination handshake state to use independent asynchronous reset domains without coordinated recovery.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Both ends reset in their own domain and the level handshake self-heals after either side alone resets.

labels.by: gpt-6.1-sol (separate settling reader, the case and both arguments only)
labels.note: Starting from settled phase 1, a new request toggles req_src_q; resetting only the destination forces ack_dst_q to 0 (line 35), acknowledging a request it never observed. The equality at line 47 can report completion for a request erased by reset.

settled_by: third reading; verdict bad (2 of 3 readings)
